summary: Re-tested Periodization Models feature after reset-defaults fix. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass, including previously-failing test_reset_defaults_preserves_custom. Manual curl verification confirms POST /api/periodization-library/reset-defaults now returns 29 defaults AND preserves existing custom models (1 custom preserved in test). Frontend E2E: login -> Datos -> plan selection -> Herramientas -> Modelos loads PeriodizationModelsManager with all 29 defaults grouped into 6 categories (Clásico 4, Ondulatorio 4, Avanzado 7, Específico 6, Fuerza 4, Equipo 4) including 'Tradicional (Matveiev)' and 'ATR (Issurin)'. Full CRUD flow verified: Create 'E2E Test Model' with phase 'Base' -> appears in Custom section; Edit rename to 'E2E Edited' -> grid updates; Duplicate -> '(Copia)' appears; Delete -> confirm dialog opened and model removed. One minor UI gap: the 'MIO' badge mentioned in the spec is not visible on custom model cards in the grid (cards show name+author+phases but no explicit 'MIO' badge; the Custom category label alone distinguishes them).

minor.issue: Returns 403 Not authenticated when called WITH trailing slash via the public URL (Kubernetes ingress appears to drop Authorization header on the 307 redirect). The no-slash variant works (200). Frontend uses no-slash so users are not affected, but any client using trailing slash will break.

ui_bugs.issue: Spec asks for 'MIO' badge on user-created (custom) model cards, but the rendered card only shows name/author/phases under the 'Custom' category header without an explicit MIO badge. Low priority but visible deviation from spec.

issues: Hydration warnings: '<tr> cannot be child of <span>' and '<span> cannot be child of <tbody>' emitted from DashboardPage around indicadorKeys rendering (line ~4193). Pre-existing, not related to Modelos feature.

action_items: (Optional) Add visible 'MIO' badge on custom model cards to match spec.
(Optional) Normalise trailing-slash behaviour on POST /api/periodization-library so ingress redirect preserves the auth header, or remove the duplicated no-slash route. Not user-impacting today.
(Optional, pre-existing) Fix the <tr>-inside-<span> hydration warning in DashboardPage indicadorKeys block.
critical_code_review_comments: reset_defaults now correctly inlines the 29-doc insert instead of relying on _seed_user_library_if_empty — the fix matches what iteration_44 recommended. Good.

Wizard integration testids ('model-option-{id}') were not re-verified end-to-end in this iteration because core Modelos CRUD consumed the test budget; the data layer is proven (29 defaults grouped by category are returned by the API), so wizard should render them correctly.
Custom model cards do not surface a 'MIO' badge even though PeriodizationComplete styling uses 'MIO' in the wizard; the manager grid is inconsistent with that convention.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% - Modelos page list, group-by-category, create, edit, duplicate, delete all verified; MIO-badge UI detail missing; wizard integration not re-verified due to token budget

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Preserve and E2E Test Model/E2E Edited/(Copia) during testing. All cleaned up after test. Final DB state: 29 defaults, 0 customs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: reset-defaults fix VERIFIED at backend (pytest + curl with custom preservation). Modelos UI flow VERIFIED end-to-end except: (1) 'MIO' badge cosmetic gap on custom cards, (2) wizard Crear Plan step-2 rendering with model-option-{id} testids was not re-run in this iteration. If the main agent adds the MIO badge it is a ~2-line change in PeriodizationModelsManager.js around the card render (already uses is_default flag, so conditional JSX on !m.is_default).

rca_of_the_issue.reset_defaults_fix_confirmation: The reset_defaults endpoint now deletes is_default=True docs then unconditionally inserts 29 documents built inline from DEFAULT_PERIODIZATION_LIBRARY. Verified with a custom model present before the call: after reset, response contained exactly 29 defaults + the preserved custom (total 30). After cleanup, final collection state is 29 defaults + 0 customs as expected.
